name: Toronto Water 2026-2035 Capital Budget and Plan
known_limitations: The plan establishes adopted program funding, project categories, service measures, and stated delivery constraints. It does not establish a named site's servicing capacity, procurement completion, construction progress, or project-specific water and wastewater commitments.
automation_notes: Track annual plan changes, delivery constraints, project reallocations, awards, construction, and in-service records.
notes: The document records an $18.893 billion ten-year gross capital program and warns that projected reserve balances fall below 2% of capital investment over the plan period.
